+"""Intent tests for M1-T19: risk.summary_stats, the whole-period summary (RISK-04, TC-07)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk import Returns, TickerSummary, VolSeries, summary_stats
+
+
+def _vol(data: dict) -> VolSeries:
+    returns = data["returns"]
+    return VolSeries(
+        returns=Returns(
+            base_date=returns["base_date"],
+            dates=tuple(returns["dates"]),
+            tickers=tuple(returns["tickers"]),
+            values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in returns["values"].items()},
+        ),
+        window=data["window"],
+        annualized=data["annualized"],
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in data["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def _truncated(data: dict, n: int) -> VolSeries:
+    returns = data["returns"]
+    return VolSeries(
+        returns=Returns(
+            base_date=returns["base_date"],
+            dates=tuple(returns["dates"][:n]),
+            tickers=tuple(returns["tickers"]),
+            values={t: tuple(v[:n]) for t, v in returns["values"].items()},
+        ),
+        window=data["window"],
+        annualized=data["annualized"],
+        values={t: tuple(v[:n]) for t, v in data["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def _by_ticker(summary: tuple[TickerSummary, ...]) -> dict[str, TickerSummary]:
+    return {s.ticker: s for s in summary}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc07_one_summary_per_ticker_in_ticker_order(golden):
+    given, expected = golden("risk", "TC-07")
+    summary = summary_stats(_vol(given["vol"]))
+    assert all(isinstance(s, TickerSummary) for s in summary)
+    assert [s.ticker for s in summary] == [row["ticker"] for row in expected["summary"]]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("field", ["ann_return", "ann_vol", "sharpe"])
+def test_tc07_annualized_statistics(golden, field):
+    given, expected = golden("risk", "TC-07")
+    got = _by_ticker(summary_stats(_vol(given["vol"])))
+    for row in expected["summary"]:
+        assert getattr(got[row["ticker"]], field) == pytest.approx(row[field], abs=expected["tol"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc07_zero_volatility_gives_zero_sharpe(golden):
+    given, expected = golden("risk", "TC-07")
+    got = _by_ticker(summary_stats(_vol(given["vol"])))
+    y = next(row for row in expected["summary"] if row["ticker"] == "Y")
+    assert got["Y"].ann_vol == pytest.approx(y["ann_vol"], abs=expected["tol"])
+    assert got["Y"].sharpe == pytest.approx(y["sharpe"], abs=expected["tol"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc07_last_rolling_vol_is_reported(golden):
+    given, expected = golden("risk", "TC-07")
+    got = _by_ticker(summary_stats(_vol(given["vol"])))
+    for row in expected["summary"]:
+        last = got[row["ticker"]].last_vol
+        assert last is not None
+        assert last == pytest.approx(row["last_vol"], abs=expected["tol"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc07_default_is_252_periods_per_year(golden):
+    given, expected = golden("risk", "TC-07")
+    vol = _vol(given["vol"])
+    default = _by_ticker(summary_stats(vol))
+    explicit = _by_ticker(summary_stats(vol, periods_per_year=252))
+    for row in expected["summary"]:
+        assert explicit[row["ticker"]].ann_return == pytest.approx(
+            row["ann_return"], abs=expected["tol"]
+        )
+        assert default[row["ticker"]] == explicit[row["ticker"]]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("n", [0, 1])
+def test_fewer_than_two_returns_is_a_value_error(golden, n):
+    given, _ = golden("risk", "TC-07")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"(?i)return"):
+        summary_stats(_truncated(given["vol"], n))

10	    """Annualized return, volatility, Sharpe and last rolling vol per ticker.
11	
12	    The annualized return is `periods_per_year` times the mean daily return, the annualized
13	    volatility is its square root times the sample stdev, and Sharpe is their quotient
14	    (0.0 when the volatility is 0; no risk-free rate). The last vol is the latest rolling value
15	    that exists, None if there is none. ValueError with fewer than two returns.
16	    """
17	    returns = vol.returns
18	    if len(returns.dates) < 2:
19	        raise ValueError(f"summary needs at least two returns, got {len(returns.dates)}")
20	    summaries = []
21	    for ticker in returns.tickers:
22	        series = returns.values[ticker]
23	        ann_return = periods_per_year * fmean(series)
24	        ann_vol = sqrt(periods_per_year) * stdev(series)
25	        summaries.append(
26	            TickerSummary(
27	                ticker=ticker,
28	                ann_return=ann_return,
29	                ann_vol=ann_vol,
30	                sharpe=ann_return / ann_vol if ann_vol > 0 else 0.0,
